scope: Conditional classification of the declared domestic expenditure-package vocabulary, alongside the existing HU2023 national industry accounts and descriptive employment attachment. No programme expenditure, supplier allocation, coefficient or effect estimate.

source_artifacts.document_revision: Displayed metadata update; not HU national IOT revision
EEEA/2020/02; Table1 references CPA2008 and is context only, not automatic CPA2.1 authority
NACE Rev.2 explanatory manual; publication KS-RA-07-015-EN

routes.qualification: Heat-pump/refrigerating equipment within this historical class; establish domestic-type and equipment boundary from the actual specification.
routes.exclusions: Do not classify a named WM50 configuration, whole installation or every heat pump by label alone.

routes.qualification: Actual air-conditioning machine within the source class.
routes.exclusions: No blanket mapping of all heat pumps or all new-version correspondence targets.

routes.qualification: Separately identified heating/ventilation installation service or installed-work output.
routes.exclusions: Not the manufacturer class; do not additionally count embedded purchased equipment as final expenditure.

routes.qualification: Rechargeable accumulator within the old mixed class; chemistry and item boundary must be known.
routes.exclusions: Old code is broader than lithium-ion; it does not classify an entire battery/inverter/control installation.

routes.qualification: Non-starter lead-acid accumulator when the specification establishes that chemistry.
routes.exclusions: A conditional alternative, not the selected project chemistry.

routes.qualification: Separately identified inverter/converter equipment within the old source class.
routes.exclusions: Not a part of accumulator output to count again when already embedded in an installed service.

routes.qualification: Building electrical installation/connection service, when separately identified.
routes.exclusions: Grid line construction is a different route; no connection permission or operational eligibility follows.

routes.qualification: Separately identified local electricity-line construction works.
routes.exclusions: No attribution of a whole framework award or general network budget to this programme.

routes.qualification: Glass-fibre mat/board or similar material within the source class, including qualifying glass wool.
routes.exclusions: Not all mineral wool or all envelope materials; do not count again inside installed-work output.

routes.qualification: Other qualifying mineral insulation within the broad class, with product details.
routes.exclusions: Broad residual mineral class is not wholly insulation or wholly programme output.

routes.qualification: Qualifying cellular plastic sheet/board material; identify material and form.
routes.exclusions: Not a classification of every polymer product or installed insulation system.

routes.qualification: Qualifying wood/ligneous fibreboard; identify actual product form.
routes.exclusions: Not every bio-based material; source class includes other uses.

routes.qualification: Identified installed thermal insulation works.
routes.exclusions: No additional final-demand line for embedded materials already in the work price.

routes.qualification: Wooden window/door goods when replacement is required and material confirmed.
routes.exclusions: No automatic replacement requirement; finishing services and installed works remain distinct.

routes.qualification: Plastic window/door goods within the source class and actual scope.
routes.exclusions: No automatic replacement requirement; material alternatives are not additive purchases.

routes.qualification: Metal window/door goods within the source class and actual scope.
routes.exclusions: No automatic replacement requirement or assignment of mixed-material totals.

routes.qualification: Installation of ordinary windows/doors; identify the service boundary.
routes.exclusions: Automated/revolving doors are excluded from this NACE route; embedded goods are not extra final demand.

routes.qualification: Contract output that actually qualifies as residential construction/renovation works, at the published broader product level.
routes.exclusions: An invoice combining unrelated equipment and specialist services does not automatically become this class; preserve unallocated bundle residual.

routes.qualification: Separately supplied residential architectural design service.
routes.exclusions: No allocation of all administration or installation to architecture.

routes.qualification: Separately supplied building engineering service.
routes.exclusions: Actual professional scope and supplier are required for expenditure attribution.

routes.qualification: Separately supplied construction project-management service within the product class.
routes.exclusions: No arbitrary overhead percentage or double count inside a main contract.

routes.qualification: Separately supplied technical testing/analysis service within the old class.
routes.exclusions: The classification does not establish accreditation, independence or legal acceptance.

routes.qualification: Identified vocational secondary education service; the route retains the source class level.
routes.exclusions: Not all training, not instantaneous qualified labour capacity, no FTE conversion.

routes.qualification: Vocational service not otherwise classifiable by education level, within the native product subclass.
routes.exclusions: Secondary, post-secondary and higher education are not silently relabelled as this route.

routes.qualification: Separately evidenced wholesale trade-service margin.
routes.exclusions: Never assign the full resale value of equipment to trade output; no invented margin rate.

routes.qualification: Separately evidenced retail trade-service margin.
routes.exclusions: Never assign the full retail invoice to trade output; no invented margin rate.

routes.qualification: Separately identified paid road-freight service. Treat as a transport margin only under the source-specific purchase/use, invoice and contracting conditions.
routes.exclusions: Embedded manufacturer/trader transport stays in the corresponding basic price/trade margin; household-arranged third-party transport for final consumption is a separate transport service. No duplicate freight or automatic margin.

classification_basis.national_numeric_source: HU2023 national ModelD industry-by-industry, national vintage2025, current-price millionHUF/basic prices; imports CIF
classification_basis.figaro_import_valuation: FOB, not interchangeable with national CIF
classification_basis.employment_basis: Native domestic persons and actual hours; descriptive source vintage mismatch retained
classification_basis.education_alias: National IO/employment P corresponds to FIGARO industry P85 and product CPA_P85. This is a classification correspondence only.

package_boundary.mixed_bundle: Keep actual contract output and unresolved component residual; no default split or simultaneous installed-output plus embedded-material final expenditure.
package_boundary.route_selection: Conditional reference sets, not automated classification of a named product or invoice.
package_boundary.actual_supplier: The characteristic activity of a product does not establish the actual producer, importer, wholesaler or installer industry.
package_boundary.monetary_bridge: No amount, package weight, supplier distribution or purchaser-to-basic-price adjustment is supplied. A future monetary consumer must evidence these separately.
package_boundary.transfer: A subsidy/loan/guarantee is a financing transaction, not a product purchase or GDP contribution by itself.

origin_ratio_contract.grain: One named origin-use cell: nonoverlapping national industry leaf or TOTAL row, by industry leaf or native final/control use column; HU2023 MIO_NAC
origin_ratio_contract.nonnegative_share: Only if total>0 and domestic>=0 and imported>=0
origin_ratio_contract.signed: Retain exact ratio separately labelled signed accounting ratio, never a bounded propensity; no clamp
origin_ratio_contract.excluded: Accounting rows including GVA/output/import-account rows; overlapping industry parents; embodied imports; purchaser-price or programme import leakage

applicability_boundaries: Current classifications do not update the historical numeric source.
CPA2.2 target relations are retained for version checking; no automatic conversion or reverse allocation.
Gross output is not GVA, GDP or net programme benefit.
Persons/actual hours are not FTE, permanent jobs or person-years of incremental employment.
No joint labour/output coefficients are admitted across the incompatible accounting snapshots.
Original task acceptance is conditional on independent review and hosted zero-skip validation; no acceptance asserted by this candidate.

price_conversion_contract.valuation: Purchaser prices, deductible/non-deductible VAT, net product taxes, trade and transport margins must be kept explicit; no numeric conversion is supplied.
price_conversion_contract.trade_margin: Trade output is its margin, not the equipment resale value. Preserve source-signed margins rather than clipping.
price_conversion_contract.transport: Contracting party, use and invoicing determine margin versus service treatment. Embedded transport is not counted again.
price_conversion_contract.import: Domestic purchase location does not establish domestic production origin. National CIF and FIGARO FOB require a separate evidenced bridge before numeric combination.
price_conversion_contract.currency_year: 2023 current-price millionHUF is not a 2028 programme invoice or EUR value.

expected_historical_origin_ratio_coverag.count_semantics: Named query positions; TOTAL and control/final-use columns overlap and are not an additive partition.
